settings.repere: Paragraphe · Premature hair aging is a multifaceted…
settings.text: Premature hair aging is a multifaceted problem caused by several biological mechanisms happening at once. Pigment cells are slowing down, follicle anchorage is weakening, and oxidative stress is accelerating it all. A single-target solution may only address one of these symptoms or temporarily mask the visible presentation of them. By targeting key biological pathways associated with visible signs of premature hair aging like oxidative stress, hair shedding, and hair graying with targeted multi-pathway technology, FutureIQ™ serum addresses the full picture of what's actually driving the visible changes.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · FutureIQ™ is specifically designed for…
settings.text: FutureIQ™ is specifically designed for anyone experiencing signs of premature hair and scalp aging. It works best for those with less than 30% gray and minimal to moderate hair shedding.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Rapid weight loss is often associated …
settings.text: Rapid weight loss is often associated with increased hair shedding and visible changes in hair density. FutureIQ™ was not developed to treat GLP-1 side effects, medication-related shedding, or medical hair-loss conditions. FutureIQ™ is a cosmetic product designed to support scalp condition and fuller-looking, healthier-feeling hair during periods when those may notice changes in hair quality, density, or resilience. If shedding is sudden, severe, or persistent, consult your doctor or dermatologist.
